findings.detail: F-1 (blocks C04+C16): integration HEAD be70568 tree is not clean -- research/audits/v7p/golden_vector_report.json modified uncommitted. Committed copy cross-references superseded contract_sha256 db17c11e... while the committed resolved_run_contract.json (regenerated in 22f6e21) has sha256 7f358397..., i.e. HEAD contains an internally inconsistent evidence pair. The working-tree copy is correct and is deterministically rewritten by every full-suite run; integrator failed to recommit it after regenerating the contract. No functional impact: contract conformance and all engine tests pass with either copy present in tree. Fix = one commit at integration HEAD, then re-run C04/C16 checks.

F-2: expected integration composition not fully met -- A7 protocol commit 5e1918e (research/audits/v7p/challenge_memo_v7p.md) is NOT an ancestor of attested HEAD be70568. All role commits a2..a6 are present but as a linear cherry-pick chain (12 commits, single-parent), not merges. Audit protocol memo therefore absent from PRIMARY evidence tree.

F-3: vm_stat pages_free measured very low (4076 pages x16384B ~ 63MiB raw); memory_pressure reports system-wide 47% free so headroom exists (suite ran in 33.59s without pressure). Monitor during 12h V7 run.

F-4: baseline_root.json pins source_head=integration_head=684ecac (launch root per launch_sha semantics) while HEAD has advanced to be70568 via evidence-only commits. Immutability verified regardless: all spec/code hashes recomputed from live files match baseline. Recommend refreshing/confirming baseline root at final launch lock after F-1 remediation.

blockers: C04 FAIL: integration HEAD tree dirty (1 uncommitted regenerated-evidence file, no declared exemption) -- PLAN §7 admits no partial gate pass
C16 FAIL: uncommitted evidence edit persists after full suite (same root cause as C04)
